simple.meaning: זָרַב (zârab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to flow away.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 6:17. The surrounding contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָרַב (H2215) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זָרַב (zârab) / H2215 is traced through Job 6:17 with source-language evidence and verse context.

VBm ( are straitened ) RVm ( shrink ) compare Aramaic compress , (Arabic is to make a wooden enclosure ), Assyrian zarâbu , Zim BP 32 n. 56, 70, 95 ).
